dataset.name: CelebA-Spoof
dataset.official_terms: non-commercial research only; dataset images and derived data may not be published or redistributed
dataset.provenance_status: official structure and annotation semantics observed, but the Kaggle mirror is not an official distribution and its redistribution authority is not evidenced

label_mapping.cross_checks: source folder, spoof type and live/spoof field must agree; inconsistent rows are excluded

splits.method: official test retained; official train subjects divided into train/validation with seed 42; subject/path/hash leakage validator executed before training

threshold_and_test.observed_selection_policy: equal-error threshold selected from validation scores
threshold_and_test.blueprint_policy_compatibility: unresolved: equal-error selection is not explicitly one of the frozen blueprint policy names

completion_blockers: Export the exact pad_train.csv, pad_val.csv and pad_test.csv files whose hashes are recorded above.
Export the Kaggle pre-install and post-install environment reports with exact ONNX package versions.
Export training_history.json and validation/test score artifacts needed for independent threshold-policy verification.
Resolve the authority/provenance of the third-party Kaggle mirror or document acquisition from the official distribution.
Freeze a blueprint-compatible threshold policy before claiming the PAD threshold task complete.

scope_disposition.decision: third-party PAD training reproducibility deferred outside the final academic-prototype scope
scope_disposition.future_reactivation: All completion blockers apply again if reproducible-research, production, commercial or certified-security scope is reopened.
